title: Q-CLEANROOM-boot: a new system does not bring up boot on its own
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** cleanroom run, daily
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation cleanroom --probe boot
**Status:** open

CLEANROOM-1: a sandbox built from nothing but seed/ and an idea did not bring up `boot` (the bootstrap runs every stage without a blocked one) with zero human steps.

Evidence (2026-11-27T03:58:09Z): constitute: 1 constitution disagreement(s): standing rule PR-NEVER-LOSE-1 is in the agent instructions but has no entry in doctrine/constitution.json (add a rule with its detector and remediation, or list it under `covers`)

Paths: seed/, doctrine/cleanroom.json, foundation/cleanroom.py.

size: M

**Closing probe:** python3 -m foundation cleanroom --probe boot passes
